name: Mishma
overview: Mishma was a male descendant of Ishmael, identified as the fifth-born son of Ishmael. He belonged to the tribe named after him, the tribe of Mishma. There are no additional notes recorded about his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Mishma means "rumor" in the original language. It is a proper name mentioned explicitly in Genesis 25:14. The name was not given by God but is part of the biblical genealogical record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Mishma as a son of Ishmael, making him part of the Ishmaelite lineage. Beyond this father-son relationship, no other family connections are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Mishma's significance lies primarily in his role within the genealogy of Ishmael's descendants. As the fifth son of Ishmael, he represents one of the foundational figures in the formation of the Ishmaelite tribes. His mention in Genesis 25:14 situates him within God's providential plan for the descendants of Abraham through Ishmael.
